title: New branch
passage: What do you think of the new branch location? A. The tree needs its branches cut. B. It will be much easier for commuters to reach. C. The branch opens next month.
passageZh:
你覺得新分店的地點如何？
A. 那棵樹需要修剪樹枝。
B. 通勤族要到那裡會方便得多。
C. 分店下個月開幕。
